instagram.author: jonimperial
instagram.body:
MacBook App Worth Paying For

If there’s one paid app that has been crucial to my workflow, it’s this.

#macbook #macbookneo #appstore
If there's one paid app I would recommend you get for your new MacBook, it would be this one. So did you know that your MacBook has a built-in window management tool? All you need to do is press Function and Control, and you can move it to the left, to the right, top half, bottom half. You can press Function, Control, F for full screen. It's pretty handy, but it is limited. So what I like to use is an app called Magnet, and it allows you to do so much more. With Magnet, you can fill a third of your screen. You can do 2/3 and you can even do a quarter of your screen with simple shortcuts. And trust me, the more you use this, the more you'll get used to the shortcuts. Most of the time I like working in this 2/3, 1/3 configuration or 1/3, 1/3, 1/3 like this. And Magnet makes it so much easier for me to quickly change my setup. This is not a sponsored video, I just really like this app, but let me know if this is something you would pay for, and make sure to follow for more.
